noise_rule: real sigma^2 = sum(active_bit.^2)/(2*10^(EbN0_dB/10)); two-sided PSD N0/2
frequency_assumption: 13875/14125 Hz: our symmetric choice around 14 kHz with 250 Hz spacing; paper does not specify exact BFSK tones
timing_assumption: symbol_s is active duration; guard_s adds silence; known timing; no channel estimation or synchronization
acceptance_rule: zero noiseless errors and absolute theoretical-binomial z score <= 3.5 at each of four points; 95% Wilson intervals reported separately
scope: AWGN implementation validation only, not Watermark or a reproduction of the paper tables
